speaker: CAPTAIN MARK
text: This is captain mark from Earth's Defense force.
If you are listening to this tape, then...
How we vanished... is a mystery.
But... I believe in my crew, the last humans alive will figure a way to thrive again.
They'll find a cure to... what made us extinct.
Wether it was natural causes, or the atomic bombs...
This is your captain speaking, farewell soldiers.
